name: Jagiellonian University
summary: Kraków university founded in 1364, almost 40,000 students; seven English bachelor's, a Una Europa joint degree, Medicine and Dentistry.

handoff.label: Programmes taught in foreign languages (all levels)

ib.text: No IB points or subjects are set: non-Polish applicants to most English bachelor's are ranked on an online interview in English alone. The IB needs no apostille or translation.

lastYear.text: round 1: 23 February–9 March; round 2 until 11 May

programmes.name: Earth Sciences in a Changing World
programmes.about: Geography, geology and human change to the environment, and how they shape local communities and global change, with lab and field work at the Faculty of Geography and Geology.
programmes.selectionNote: Online interview in English (100%). It did not run in 2026/27 but is in UJ's 2027/28 admission rules with 40 places for non-Polish citizens.

programmes.name: East European Studies: Languages and Discourses
programmes.about: Eastern Europe's history, cultures, conflicts and discourses, taught in English, with two of Russian, Ukrainian or Polish trained to B2+ and B1+.
programmes.selectionNote: Ranked 100% on an online interview in English; IB grades do not count. 15 places for non-Polish citizens in 2027.

programmes.name: European Studies
programmes.about: European politics, culture and society through political, sociological and economic lenses; from year two you specialise in Governing Europe and CEE politics or in Social Change in Europe.
programmes.selectionNote: Ranked 100% on an online interview in English; IB grades do not count. 60 places for non-Polish citizens in 2027.

programmes.name: Global and Development Studies
programmes.about: Globalisation and international development across law, politics, economy, history, society and culture, taught at the Faculty of International and Political Studies.
programmes.selectionNote: Ranked 100% on an online interview in English; IB grades do not count. 60 places for non-Polish citizens in 2027.

programmes.name: International Relations and Area Studies
programmes.about: The global system compared region by region: international relations with area studies, language training and cross-cultural analysis.
programmes.selectionNote: Ranked 100% on an online interview in English; IB grades do not count. 60 places for non-Polish citizens in 2027.

programmes.name: Mathematics and Computer Science Advanced Track
programmes.about: A small research-led maths and computer science degree: a personal mentor from year one, tutorials, research projects and a wide choice of courses.
programmes.ib: An English interview on maths and computing beyond the school syllabus decides entry; you need 80% of its points and upload proof of your achievements.
programmes.selectionNote: Ranked on the interview alone; under 80% means no place. International olympiad medallists get full marks without it. 15 places for non-Polish citizens in 2027.

programmes.name: Responsible Entrepreneurship and Management
programmes.about: Management and entrepreneurship with a focus on sustainability and the digital economy: start-up culture, data-driven innovation and running organisations internationally, in modules.
programmes.selectionNote: Ranked 100% on an online interview in English; IB grades do not count. 20 places for non-Polish citizens in 2027.

programmes.name: Joint Bachelor in Sustainability
programmes.about: A Una Europa joint degree: year one in Kraków on sustainability basics, then one of six three-semester tracks led by partners such as Helsinki, Paris 1, Madrid or KU Leuven.
programmes.ib: Online entrance exam in English; you also need an English certificate such as IELTS Academic 6.5, TOEFL iBT 90 or Cambridge 176.
programmes.selectionNote: Ranked on an online exam (0-100) on reading texts and data and on set sustainability readings; one list for all citizenships, 180 places in 2027.

programmes.name: Medicine, Program in English
programmes.about: The six-year medical degree of UJ's School of Medicine in English, running since 1994 with students from about twenty countries; taught in Kraków by UJ and visiting faculty.
programmes.ib: Online entrance exam in English; IELTS 6.5, TOEFL iBT 87 or C1 Advanced; chemistry plus biology or physics on your certificate.

needs.note: A completed course with a grade on your certificate
A completed course with a grade on your certificate

programmes.selectionNote: Ranked on a 100-question online exam alone. 2026 also took English-medium school or Danish English 7; the 2027 rule lists only certificates, so ask.

programmes.name: Dentistry, Program in English
programmes.about: The five-year dental degree of UJ's School of Medicine in English, taught alongside the English medical programme at the Faculty of Medicine in Kraków.
programmes.ib: Online entrance exam in English; IELTS 6.5, TOEFL iBT 87 or C1 Advanced; chemistry plus biology or physics on your certificate.

needs.note: A completed course with a grade on your certificate
A completed course with a grade on your certificate

programmes.selectionNote: Ranked on the same 100-question online exam as Medicine. 2026 also took English-medium school or Danish English 7; the 2027 rule lists only certificates.

notes: Without Polish citizenship you apply through admission for foreigners, EU citizens included, and pay the programme's fee; only the Joint Bachelor in Sustainability has a lower EU/EEA fee.
Most programmes rank you on an online interview alone, so you can apply before your IB results; you need the diploma in hand by enrolment in September.
The Una Europa Bachelor in European Studies can start in Kraków, but you apply to it through KU Leuven.
